 Students Turn to Private Lenders After Trump’s Clampdown on Federal Loans
 Private lender in South Carolina lowers its credit-score requirement for certain grad students to meet growing demand
 By 
 Oyin Adedoyin 
 Listen
 (1 min)
 Sophie Park / Reuters Students are increasingly turning to private lenders after the Trump administration’s clampdown on federal student loans , and navigating greater unpredictability with interest rates and loan terms.
 In some cases, they might not qualify for private loans at all.
